dialogue_texts: Koko
Why have you returned, My Majesty? Also, who's this?
Hiroyuki
Hiroyuki Shirogane, head of the Shirogane Manor.
Koko
So some cool man just shows up and he's part of your group?
Yukari
My, what an unruly little sweeper.
Yukari
I simply brought him along because he understands the architecture of this lovely maze.
Yukari
It saves me the trouble of breaking down every door.
Hiroyuki
Do not underestimate the situation, My Majesty.
Hiroyuki
The spiritual framework of the courtyard is twisting violently. We are dealing with an intentional inversion.
Koko
Exactly! And you're not shifting any of your creepy gaps in my courtyard!
Koko
I don't care if you're some legendary youkai queen - you're just clutter in the path of my broom!
